title: discern config document

$schema.description: Editor-only pointer to this schema; ignored by discern.

version.description: Document major version. Omit (assumed current) or use a matching major; this build understands version 2.

slug.description: Project slug: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or digit.

brief.description: Free-text description of what the project is.

agents.description: Which agent integrations to enable: claude_code -> CLAUDE.md, gemini -> GEMINI.md, codex / cursor / copilot -> AGENTS.md.

description.description: Preset metadata, shown when listing presets; ignored by `setup --config`.

docs.description: [docs] settings — chiefly the project-relative directory holding discern's agent documentation tree.

dir.description: Where discern's agent documentation tree lives, relative to the project root. `discern setup` scaffolds it here and `discern docs` browses it by default.

capabilities.description: [capabilities] fills — a known capability name mapped to a command (or list). The gate stage is derived from the name; the set is closed.

format.description: fix stage — a formatter/codemod (mutating; runs first, serially).

build.description: build stage — produce artifacts later stages read (compile, bundle).

smoke.description: test stage — a fast, side-effect-light check that the app boots in THIS checkout (a framework's inspire/about, a CLI --version, a config-load-and-exit); proves viability wherever the gate runs, including inside a worktree. Not an e2e suite.

checks.description: [checks.<name>] fills — custom gate work outside the known capability vocabulary.

stage.description: When the check runs in the gate (fix|build|check|test).

provides.description: Optional free-text label, for humans / audit.

scopes.description: [scopes.<name>] tables — a named region defined by `paths`, with optional attributes.

paths.description: The globs that define the scope: a directory prefix (src/**), a standard glob (src/**/*.ext, src/*), a *.ext suffix at any depth, a /seg/ segment, or an exact path.

neutral.description: true: changes here need no gate (docs, agent guidance).

previewable.description: true: a person could see changes here — worth a preview link.

gate.description: A command discern done runs when this scope changed (a sub-component with its own self-contained gate).

standards.description: [standards.<name>] tables. Coverage is just a conventional name.

metric.description: Metric name the run emits (default: the standard name).

direction.description: "up": limit is a floor; "down": limit is a ceiling.

run.description: The command whose output emits the metric line: DISCERN_METRIC <metric> <number>.

per.description: Divide the metric to hold a *rate*, not a raw count — so the number doesn't rise just because the project grew. Either a second metric the run emits, or a built-in extent discern measures itself: per = { words = "${docs.dir}**" } (files | lines | words | bytes over a git pathspec).

scale.description: Multiply the rate by this so the limit reads in human units, e.g. scale = 1000 for "per 1,000 words".

margin.description: Headroom `discern standards --pin` leaves when it tightens this limit to the measured value: pin sets a floor to measured−margin (up) or a ceiling to measured+margin (down), and leaves a standard un-pinned when the improvement is smaller than its margin. Must be ≥ 0. Default 0 pins to the exact measured value; give a metric that drifts on unrelated changes (bundle size, coverage) a margin so a pinned limit isn't tripped by ordinary fluctuation.

description: The declarative config shape consumed by `discern setup --config <file>` and by a preset's `preset.json`. Its capabilities/checks/scopes/standards are written into a project's discern.toml via the comment-preserving editor. Every field is optional.
